remarks: Welcome to the "Eastview" - a sophisticated, stylish, and completely move-in ready condo in the much sought-after Eastview Condominium complex. This unit offers modern living with exceptional convenience. Enter through your private entrance or directly from your attached garage into a bright, beautifully updated space that lives far larger than its footprint. The refreshed kitchen features sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a clean contemporary design perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The spa-inspired full bath has been thoughtfully renovated with a stunning walk-in shower, modern finishes, and elevated fixtures. Central air conditioning and heat provide year-round comfort, while in-unit laundry adds effortless functionality. Sliders open to a private outdoor deck, creating the perfect extension of living space. Eastview is a well-managed, intimate complex known for its low common charges and prime location-just minutes to SONO, Norwalk Hospital, and all major commuting routes. Turnkey, modern, and ideally located-this is Norwalk condo living at its best.
